articles.title: Anthropic reveals plans for blockbuster IPO
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence giant Anthropic, the company behind the popular Claude chatbot, has filed papers to sell shares to the public for the first time.

articles.title: Will Harry Kane win tonight's Ballon d'Or?
articles.summary: Tonight's Ballon d'Or is one of the most anticipated in years, with Harry Kane the favourite to be named the world's best men's footballer.

articles.title: North Korean howitzer guns spotted close to border with South Korea
articles.summary: North Korean howitzer guns have been seen close to the border with South Korea - at a time when tensions between the two nations are high.

articles.title: Three men arrested in shootout after deadly attack on church in Jordan
articles.summary: Three men have been arrested after a deadly attack on a church in Jordan last week.

articles.title: Mariupol veteran who flew in classified mission on what every Ukrainian should know
articles.summary: "Everyone in Ukraine should know how to apply a tourniquet and how to stop someone's bleeding," Anatolii says.

articles.title: Talks between Ukraine, Russia and US to be held next month
articles.summary: A meeting between Ukraine, Russia and the US will take place next month, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said.

articles.title: Bus and lorry collide killing 22, including passengers returning from funeral
articles.summary: At least 22 people have been killed after a bus and lorry collided in Kenya, police say.

articles.title: British and French paratroopers take part in major wargame in Germany
articles.summary: Over 2,500 British and French troops have taken part in a wargame in Germany designed to show how NATO territory could be defended against an attack.
